owner: dotfiles-runtime daemon run (the hub, sole emitter)

versioning.non_breaking: additive method | signal | topic | optional field stays on org.dotfiles.Events1
versioning.coexistence: Events1 and Events2 may coexist on the bus under distinct interface names during migration

delivery.ordering: per-topic monotonic seq (u) within an epoch (u); epoch bumps and seq resets on every hub start
delivery.restart_signal: JobsCleared(epoch) on first start and every restart; consumers also watch NameOwnerChanged on org.dotfiles.Events
delivery.hydration: subscribe-then-read GetTopicState/GetActiveJobs; GetTopicState returns reserved _epoch (u) and _seq (u); drop signals whose (epoch, seq) is not greater than hydrated

capture.state.cadence: on every transition and at least once per second while recording
capture.state.notes: the bar renders the pushed elapsed_seconds (may interpolate locally); it derives no time from a file or shared wall clock
